info.name: API Reference attributions notifications > Notifications API

params.name: page[after]
params.description: Represents a cursor value, and if provided, returns the next page of results

params.name: page[before]
params.description: Represents a cursor value, and if provided, returns the previous page of results

params.name: page[size]
params.description: Maximum number of records to be returned [1 - 200], (default = 200)

params.name: filter[eventName]
params.description: Return only notifications for this event name.

params.name: filter[status]
params.description: Return only notifications with this delivery status.

params.name: filter[after]
params.description: Return only notifications created strictly after this timestamp (ISO 8601).

params.name: filter[before]
params.description: Return only notifications created strictly before this timestamp (ISO 8601).

items.docs:
Lists notifications previously dispatched to the issuer, most recent first. Results are filterable by event name, delivery status, and a `created_at` time range.
Required scopes: `notifications:read`

params.name: eventId
params.description: The event ID of the notification to replay.

items.docs:
Re-enqueues a previously dispatched notification so it is redelivered to the issuer's currently configured webhook for that event. Returns 409 when the issuer has no enabled subscription for the event.
Required scopes: `notifications:write`
